اقترضتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَضْتُنَّ (iqtaraḍtunna) /iq.ta.radˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اُقْتُرِضْتُنَّ (uqturiḍtunna) /uq.tu.ridˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
